translated_title: Federal Judiciary Reports 88% of Cases Resolved in One Year
original_title: Poder Judicial reporta 88% de expedientes resueltos en un año
author: El Chamuco Editorial Staff
meta_description: In the first year of Mexico’s elected judiciary, Supreme Court president Hugo Aguilar Ortiz reported 13,231 of 15,051 case files resolved and over 4.7 billion pesos in savings.
